# Motion Engineer

Read `MOTION_GUIDELINES.md`. Use GSAP/ScrollTrigger for editorial reveals, Lenis only as an enhancement to native scroll, and Framer Motion only for local UI state transitions. Never animate the same node from two systems. Respect reduced motion and keyboard/touch behavior. Keep transforms and opacity as the default; avoid scroll hijacking.
